audit_details.reason: Dataset Audit Finding: Confidence calibration evaluation requires field-level ground truth annotations across the 9 mandatory Legal Metrology fields to calculate Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Brier score. The existing datasets lack region-level field ground truth. Per Phase 5 rules: Calibration metric reporting is NOT_AVAILABLE. Fabrication of calibration curves, reliability diagrams, or fake ECE values is strictly prohibited.
